whenToUse: Rows of people, files, services or events, each an avatar or icon beside text, a badge or a button
Clickable menus of account pages, mailbox folders or commands, ending in a chevron, count or key
A compact record card with a header and footer, such as a project with status, team and progress

whenNotToUse.when: A finished dashboard panel of KPIs, transactions or integrations with data on every row
A whole page of account options in labeled rows, each with its own switch, select or input
Rows the user reorders by dragging them up or down the page

agentNotes: Make a row a link through `render` on the base twin or `asChild` on radix; every style draws the hover fill only when the row is an anchor
`ItemGroup` sets `role` list but `Item` sets no listitem role, so wrap each row in an element that carries it
`ItemTitle` clamps to 1 line and `ItemDescription` to 2, so longer text is cut off until a `className` lifts the clamp
